_note: Held-out evaluation set. Written after the stand-in (src/text.mjs) was frozen and never used to tune it, so it measures how well a reader generalises. Each email has the outcome a careful colleague would choose ('expected') and the correct reading of the text ('reading'), which is the ground truth for the harm check. Fictional people and companies; .example domains.
